result.question: Compare Apple's services revenue growth rate to its products revenue growth rate over the last two fiscal years.
result.answer:
However, the filings do provide disaggregated revenue data for certain quarters and nine-month periods that allow partial year-over-year comparisons.

For the first quarter of FY2025 (three months ended December 28, 2024) versus the first quarter of FY2024 (three months ended December 30, 2023), Services revenue grew from $23,117 million to $26,340 million, an increase of approximately 13.9% [0000320193-25-000007:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Over the same period, Products revenue grew from $96,458 million to $97,960 million, an increase of approximately 1.6% [0000320193-25-000007:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Services growth significantly outpaced Products growth in this quarter.

For the nine months ended June 29, 2024 (FY2024) versus the nine months ended July 1, 2023 (FY2023), Services revenue grew from $62,886 million to $71,197 million, an increase of approximately 13.2% [0000320193-24-000081:part-i--item-1-p005]. Over the same period, Products revenue (total net sales minus Services) declined from $230,901 million ($293,787 million total minus $62,886 million Services) to $224,908 million ($296,105 million total minus $71,197 million Services), a decrease of approximately 2.6% [0000320193-24-000081:part-i--item-1-p005].

For the first quarter of FY2026 (three months ended December 27, 2025) versus the first quarter of FY2025 (three months ended December 28, 2024), Services revenue grew from $26,340 million to $30,013 million, an increase of approximately 13.9% [0000320193-26-000005:ex-99-press-release-p002]. Over the same period, Products revenue grew from $97,960 million to $113,743 million, an increase of approximately 16.1% [0000320193-26-000005:ex-99-press-release-p002]. In this most recent quarter, Products growth outpaced Services growth.

 Full-year FY2023 total net sales were $383,285 million [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax:2023-09-30]. However, without a full-year Products and Services breakdown, a complete fiscal-year growth rate comparison between the two categories cannot be determined from the available evidence.

### Retracted claims

The following claims could not be verified against their cited sources and were removed from the answer:
- Apple's SEC filings do not provide a full-year Products vs. Services revenue breakdown for either of the last two fiscal years (FY2025 and FY2024).
- Total net sales for the full fiscal years were $416,161 million in FY2025 and $391,035 million in FY2024, representing overall growth of approximately 6.4%.
